Until configured, enrolment fails closed with reason governance_proposer_identity_unconfigured on references.paper_enrollment.
The governed lifecycle call mints a short-lived tenant JWT from PERSONA_JWT_SECRET / PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET; unset fails closed with a readable reason.
